tail:
This \(F\) is compact and content zero, hence Jordan, but \(F_{q_k}=C_k\) is non-Jordan for every \(k\); the exceptional rational parameter set is dense and not content-zero. Thus the missing hypothesis cannot be inferred from Jordan measurability.

   A viable repair is to apply Cavalieri only to the inner and outer rectangular figures from `[L8]`, whose sections meet the hypothesis, and then squeeze the already-proved Jordan shear image between their shears.

3. **`research/frontier-10-proof-contracts.json` and batch-5 source contract — boundary and citation records; assessment: nonfatal contract defect.**

   All eleven selected proof-bearing records reuse generic, unanchored boundary text. Examples:

   - `lem-near-identity-c-one-maps-sandwich-cubes` says the empty case was checked through “empty Jordan pieces,” although the item has no Jordan pieces and \(r>0\) makes its cube nonempty.
   - `cor-one-dimensional-change-of-variables-with-absolute-derivative` marks zero and degenerate cases checked even though \(a<b\) and \(\varphi'\ne0\) exclude them.
   - Its purported exact source clause for `thm-substitution` is only: “Then \((f\circ\varphi)\varphi'\) is integrable on \([c,d]\) and”, omitting every hypothesis and the conclusion.

   The merged and batch-5 records are identical here. These contracts do not meet the required anchored-boundary/exact-source-clause standard.
